heroHeadline: Romanian F-16 Destroys Explosive Drone Near Neptun Deep Gas Project — First Cannon-Kill of the Wave
heroSubtitle: Romania recorded two airspace incursions on the morning of August 20: a drone crashed near Grindu in Tulcea County after crossing from the Ukrainian border, and roughly three hours later a Romanian F-16 destroyed an explosive-laden maritime drone with cannon fire near the Neptun Deep offshore gas project — the Air Force's first gun kill and first maritime-drone engagement of the 154-day wave. President Nicușor Dan blamed Russia for an 'intensification of irresponsible incidents,' and EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called it part of an 'escalating campaign of threats.' The incidents bring NATO's confirmed drone shootdowns to eight across Estonia, Latvia, and Romania since March.
